dueNote: VAT returns (Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung) are due on the 10th day after each month or quarter, and income-tax prepayments on 10 March, June, September and December; pay them from the vault as they fall due. The rest of a year's reserve is released about ten months after the year ends, after the annual return and assessment.
